items.title: Aebersold Jamey — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was Greg Quigley in Australia?

ctx.x: It’s another thing when you take it and export it somewhere else. Of course, you need somebody that has the contacts, that has the bases to be able to have them. So there are some key people there who it seems like they were critical in helping this happen. There was Hans Gruber in Germany. There was Greg Quigley in Australia?
